title: OTLP dead-letter + replay bridge for Tempo wiring and tenant-safe retries
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Introduce a tenant-aware dead-letter pipeline for OTLP span envelopes that cannot be accepted by primary Tempo exporters (schema mismatches, unsupported attributes, or transient backend failures). The pipeline should: 1) reliably persist rejected span batches to durable storage with metadata, 2) surface DLQ metrics and replay health in Console dashboards, and 3) provide an automated, idempotent replay mechanism that preserves trace IDs and respects tenant rate limits and retention policies. This reduces data loss during backend upgrades and lets SREs/operators safely re-ingest problematic spans after fixups.
acceptance_criteria: Rejected OTLP batches are written to S3-compatible DLQ with tenant_id, original_sink, failure_reason, and timestamp as metadata
Console shows DLQ rate, oldest DLQ age, and replay success rate per-tenant and per-sink
Replay worker can process DLQ entries idempotently without creating duplicate traces in Tempo
Replay honors per-tenant throughput quotas and respects circuit-breaker backoff when target Tempo is unhealthy
End-to-end tests simulate schema-mismatch and Tempo 5xx, verifying DLQ write and successful manual replay flow
steps: Add DLQ layer to otlp-ingest: validate envelopes; on non-transient errors or repeated transient failures, serialize envelope + metadata and send to durable store
Schema-tag each DLQ object with schema_version and original_headers for downstream repair tooling
Implement replay service: dequeue DLQ objects, apply optional transformation hooks (contrib repair scripts), call Tempo ingest with idempotency-key derived from span traceid+batch-hash
Expose new metrics: dlq_written_total, dlq_replayed_total, dlq_replay_failures, dlq_oldest_seconds by tenant and sink
Console: add DLQ panel to Traces > Ingest health; wire alerts for dlq_growth_rate > threshold
Add e2e test harness using local-tempo-minio combo and golden traces to assert no duplicates and preserved trace relationships
progress_updates: 2025-11-07: Spike completed — validated S3-backed DLQ with mock otlp-envelopes. Found serialization edge cases for binary attributes; plan to base64-encode binary blobs in DLQ objects.

2025-11-11: Replayed proof-of-concept against local Tempo. Observed duplicate spans when replayed without idempotency key; added deterministic idempotency key computation (traceid + sha256(batch_bytes)).
2025-11-15: PR for DLQ write landed (otlp-ingest#421). Running integration tests in staging. Initial Console panels mocked behind feature flag.
2025-11-18: Identified race with tenant quota enforcement during replay; adding token-bucket check in replay-worker before outbound POSTs to Tempo.
comments: PM feedback (Leah Patel): Please ensure replay UI includes 'preview' mode so operators can inspect and optionally transform spans before replay.
Security review (Sergio Kim): Confirm DLQ storage encrypts at rest with customer KMS when tenant has private deployment; flagged for Private deployment checklist.
Design input (Maya Chen): Proposed compact timeline sparkline for DLQ growth per-tenant and a policy quick-action (start replay / archive / delete), added to Console mockups.
Eng note (Rohan Gupta): We should avoid coupling DLQ format to Tempo-specific envelope; store raw OTLP plus metadata to enable later repair for other backends.
QA (Diego Alvarez): Adding flaky test that simulates partial network failure during replay — need retry idempotency tests
